variance_decomposition.note: frac_variance_within_duplicate_groups is the share of total PCE variance among duplicate-composition rows that occurs within a fixed composition (it cannot be explained by composition, whether or not device or process variables account for it). It bounds the variance any composition-only model can explain on this subset.

verdict: Device/process-feature range within a fixed duplicate composition shows a statistically significant positive correlation with that composition's PCE range, based on the fields available (ETL/HTL/perovskite/backcontact thickness only; deposition method, annealing conditions and other process variables are not captured by these four numeric fields, so this is a partial test). Independently of that correlation test, the variance decomposition shows 72.3% of total PCE variance among duplicate-composition rows is within-composition variance that composition alone cannot explain, whether or not the available device fields capture its cause. This indicates a composition-only noise ceiling.
